candidates.change_summary: Change the block requirement from block.number + 1 to block.number + 2, delaying when settle() can be called.
Change the block requirement from block.number + 1 to block.number, allowing immediate settlement in the same block.
Remove the payment requirement (msg.value == 1 ether), allowing lockInGuess without sending ETH.
Change payment requirement from 1 ether to 2 ether.
Remove the initial require check for guesses[msg.sender].block == 0, allowing overwriting an existing guess.
Remove the requirement that the guess matches the answer, always sending 2 ether if block check passes.
Change the equality check to inequality so payout occurs when guess does NOT match answer.
Change the payout amount from 2 ether to 1 ether.
Delete the guessing block number update, leaving guesses[msg.sender].block unchanged so subsequent settles still see the guess.
Replace the block.number check with block.number >= (instead of >) so settle can be called in the same block.
Replace the blockhash input to use block.number - 1 instead of the stored block, changing the answer.
